content:
thought
The test image shows a citrus leaf with uneven yellowing/chlorosis, particularly on the right side. The affected plant part is the leaf.

Next, I will read the `part_index.md` file to see which diseases affect the leaf.

thought
The `part_index.md` file indicates that "Huanglongbing" affects the leaf, while "Whisker_Mold" affects the seed and stem. Since the test image clearly shows a diseased leaf, Huanglongbing is the primary candidate.

Now, I will review the symptom description for Huanglongbing to confirm if the symptoms in the test image align with the description.

After that, I will view the reference images for Huanglongbing. I will view one reference image from Huanglongbing first, then I will view one reference image from Whisker_Mold to ensure I have viewed at least two different classes, as per the instructions. Then, I will revisit Huanglongbing and Whisker_Mold with the remaining budget.

thought
The first reference image for Huanglongbing, `CDDM_1006.jpg`, shows a leaf with asymmetrical yellowing, similar to the test image. This reinforces Huanglongbing as a strong candidate.

Now, I will view a reference image for Whisker_Mold, even though the part index suggests it's less likely for a leaf, to fulfill the requirement of viewing at least two different classes. I will choose `Bugwood_2.jpg` from the `seed` category for Whisker_Mold.

thought
The reference image for Whisker_Mold (`Bugwood_2.jpg`) shows a fruit with mold growth and whisker-like structures. This is distinctly different from the leaf in the test image, confirming that Whisker_Mold is not the correct classification.

Now I have 6 reference image views remaining. I will continue to view reference images for Huanglongbing, as it is the most probable candidate, based on the `part_index.md` file and the symptom description. I will view `CDDM_1035.jpg` next.

thought
The second reference image for Huanglongbing, `CDDM_1035.jpg`, also shows clear signs of uneven yellowing and chlorosis on a citrus leaf, which is consistent with the test image. This further strengthens the case for Huanglongbing.

I have 5 reference image views remaining. I will view the last reference image for Huanglongbing: `CDDM_1080.jpg`.

thought
The third reference image for Huanglongbing, `CDDM_1080.jpg`, again exhibits the characteristic uneven yellowing on a citrus leaf. All three Huanglongbing reference images are very consistent with the test image.

I have 4 reference image views remaining. Since Huanglongbing seems to be a very strong match, I will now use the remaining views to re-examine Whisker_Mold, specifically looking at the stem images, to be absolutely certain there's no ambiguity, although it is highly unlikely to be the correct classification. I will start with `Bugwood_8.jpg` (seed).

thought
The reference image for Whisker_Mold, `Bugwood_8.jpg`, shows mold on a fruit. This further confirms that Whisker_Mold is not a match for the test image, which is a diseased leaf.

I have 3 reference image views remaining. I will view the last Whisker_Mold reference image, `Bugwood_15.jpg` (stem), to exhaust all available references and confirm that none of them match the test image.
